service.description: Run stardustd as a systemd/launchd service.

token.description: Token used to authorize stardust servers. Uses an auto-generated token by default. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

enableIcc.description: Enable interconnectivity between containers. Do not enable unless you know what you're doing.

host.description: The host to connect to, if using an HTTP connection.

network.description: The Docker network used for connecting to containers

port.description: The port for the docker host, if using an HTTP connection.

protocol.description: Protocol, if using an HTTP connection

socket.description: The path to the Docker socket to connect to, if using a socket connection.

type.description: The type of connection to use to connect to the Docker daemon.

blockedProcessNames.description: List of processes to block on containers. Useful if you want to stop the use of crypto miners or other resource hungry processes. Will also kill processes on the host. Will be overhauled later

dnsServers.description: DNS servers for the session to use.

limit.description: Max number of sessions allowed on this instance

memoryLimit.description: Maximum memory a container can use, in megabytes

storageLimit.description: Storage limit for containers in GB (in format nG, for example 25G) Only works if /var/lib/docker is XFS formatted with pquota enabled

vncPassword.description: Default VNC password to use. Defaults to randomly generated.
